cohort: 50 infants of diabetic mothers (IDMs) admitted to the Special Care Neonatal Unit (SCANU) of Mymensingh Medical College Hospital (MMCH), Bangladesh, irrespective of gestational age, birth weight, and type or duration of maternal diabetes.
finding: The study found a high prevalence of IDM (24/1000 live births) with common morbidities including perinatal asphyxia (50%), macrosomia (48%), neonatal jaundice (44%), hypoglycaemia (40%), hypocalcaemia (36%), and polycythemia (28%), and a mortality rate of 6%.
mod_finding: Caesarian delivery was more common than vaginal delivery (43 vs 7 cases).
